answer.verdict: TEKKEN4_SOUND=1 plays the menu bed, the intro, and a Kazuya-vs-Law round (timer 60 at 75s, 56 at 100s, 49 at 115s, 43 at 130s). The SIF DMA test passes (478/478) because the IOP heap now bumps down from 0x1F0000; the test was not edited. Non-movie rails in the 55-60s window went from 42 to 0 after the dry sum is clamped before the master multiply. Movie rails are the ADPCM decoder (1177 on the ISO) plus the bed added after that clamp. 0-5s is the same mixer silence on every sound WAV. Reverb was left in place: VMIXE is 0 at the mode-6 call.

facts.c: ps2_sif_dma_tests.cpp:203 requires the first sceSifAllocIopHeap in [0x120000, 0x200000). HeapBase is still 0x80000. allocate() bumps down from HeapLimit 0x1F0000, so the 0x880 align-64 block is 0x1EF780.
cmd /c tools/build_tests.cmd exited 0. Total Tests 478, Passed 478, Failed 0. The line 'IOP heap DMA uses private backing instead of aliasing EE RDRAM' is Passed.
facts.ref: logs/grok/sound-run-notes.md; test log call-8ea5db95 line 532 and lines 694-696

facts.c: Before the mix change, sound-run-11 (73.000s, 3504000 frames) had 42 per-channel rails in 55-60s (20 neg32768 + 22 pos32767) and 1177 rails across 20-45s (8+44+19+436+670). Other non-movie windows had 0 rails.

After the change, sound-run-12 (79.012s) 55-60s peak 32256 rails 0. sound-run-15 (100.012s, 4800560 frames) has 0 rails from 45s through 100s, with fight-window peaks 32256. 32256 is abs((-32768 * volumeOf(0x3f00)) >> 14). MVOL was logged 0x3fff then 0x3f00.

movie_peak.py on the ISO, same nibble order as the runtime, decoded 2143232 samples, peak 32768, 1177 rails. The WAV adds that PCM after the SPU clamp (ps2_audio.cpp:498-501), so movie-window rail sums can exceed 1177 (sound-run-15: 8+44+19+450+691=1212).

RMS 75-80 0.099361 peak 27547.5; 80-85 0.168134/32256; 85-90 0.200156/32256; 90-95 0.198956/32256; 95-100 0.186557/32255. Rails 0 in those windows.

facts.c: 0-5s is 0 samples on runs 11, 12, 13, 14 and 15, then the same bed (run 15: 5-10s rms 0.020598 peak 10751, 0 rails). sound-run-15 stdout: main loop frame 1000 at 16.1523s. The WAV stores mixer frames (ps2_audio.cpp push), not a header pad.
docs/status.md says the PCSX2 logo is at 18-22s including BIOS. No PCSX2 WAV was recorded this session.

sound-run-12 stderr: effect mode 6 depth 10240/10240 delay 0 feedback 0 vmixE 000000/000000 on both cores, and EVOL id 0x0b/0x0c value 0x2800 at that call. setEffectAttr enables the effect bit; wet input is VMIXEL/VMIXER.
sound-run-15 WAV is 100.012s for a 145.1s wall run. step() drops the output buffer past 2s (kMaxBufferedFrames = 48000*2). CyclesPerSample is 768.
facts.ref: logs/grok/sound-run-15/out.wav; sound_engine.cpp:16; sound_engine.h:26; grok_run exit 'ran 145.1 s'

facts.c: The top-down heap is not behind TEKKEN4_SOUND. sound-run-15 stderr has '[libsd] sound route on' and no exception line, and the round timer advanced, so AllocSysMemory(0xE9400) still succeeded on this allocator.

fix.change: Bump down from HeapLimit. The first 0x880/align-64 SIF alloc returns 0x1EF780, inside the DMA test window, while a 0xE9400 block still fits at or above HeapBase 0x80000.

Clamp the per-core dry and send sums to s16 before the master volume, and do the master multiply in int64. This matches PCSX2 clamp-then-ApplyVolume and stops the int32 wrap onto -32768 when the sum exceeds ~131075.

contra: Movie-window rail sums did not fall (sound-run-11 1177, sound-run-15 1212). The decoder itself has 1177 rails, and the bed is added after the SPU clamp, so those rails are not the int32 wrap.
The fight WAV ends at 100s while frames at 115s and 130s still show the round, so the tail of the round is not in the file.
sound-run-13, same keys about 0.5s later, sat on character select and wrote 20s of digital zeros (WAV 65-85) while the select timer moved from 20 to 08.
A TEKKEN4_SOUND-unset capture was not repeated after the heap direction change. The sound-route boot, which uses the same allocator, did reach the round.
0-5s was not compared to a PCSX2 recording.

sound-run-12 frame_55s.bmp is MODE SELECT. sound-run-14 frame_75s.bmp and frame_95s.bmp are the attract GAME OVER demo, not a played round.
open: Character select can be 20s of digital zero (sound-run-13 WAV 65-85s, timer 20 then 08 on frame_75s.bmp and frame_95s.bmp). The next check is whether a voice is keyed on that screen and what its envelope and VMIX are.
The WAV stops before the process (sound-run-15 100.012s audio vs 145.1s wall) because output follows IOP cycles and the 2s mix buffer is trimmed. frame_115 and frame_130 have no samples in the file.
VMIXE is 0 at both mode-6 effect calls, so the wet send is empty there. A later sceSdSetSwitch of VMIXEL/VMIXER is not logged. Reverb code was not changed.
No TEKKEN4_SOUND-unset capture was taken after the heap became top-down. The direction change is process-wide.
